prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1372
Claimant:
William Santos
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
11/08/2023
Claim received for a side impact collision at an intersection. Claimant is represented by counsel, and all further
contact will go through the attorney's office.
01/03/2024
Reviewed the police report and the driver's policy declarations. The claimant is named as a driver on the policy, and
the coverage period was in force at the time of the loss.
01/27/2024
Obtained statements from two independent witnesses and the other driver. All three describe the collision the same
way as the claimant did, and the photos taken at the scene are consistent with that account.
02/01/2024
Police and witnesses both confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time of impact. No record shows any
prior damage to the vehicle, and the repair estimate was requested.
02/25/2024
Received the medical records describing a shoulder injury. The nature of the injury and the force of the impact appear
to fit well together. Our file shows no earlier injury to the same area.
03/06/2024
Treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy and follow-up visits gradually decreasing as the claimant's
condition improved. The provider's notes reflect steady progress.
04/10/2024
Claimant contacted our office to add a few minor details about the sequence of events. The core account did not
change from the original statement, and the additions were consistent with the physical evidence.
04/13/2024
Reviewed the damage report with the repair appraiser. It is not yet claer whether every area of damage resulted from
this impact, so the appraiser will inspect the vehicle further before finalizing the estimate.
05/31/2024
Reviewed the medical treatment timeline against the records on file. Nothing in the file suggests the damage or injury
occurred before the coverage period started.
06/15/2024
Referred the file for final evaluation of the bodily injury and property damage components. Further correspondence
will be directed to the claimant's attorney.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
